controles.affirmation: Reglementaire/juridique : le programme de rachat d'actions est suspendu et la scission NBCUniversal peut ne jamais avoir lieu, sans garantie de neutralite fiscale
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "...could delay completion of the NBCUniversal Spin-off relative to our expected timeline or prevent it from occurring at all" ; "...qualify as tax-free and, if the NBCUniversal Spin-off is ultimately determined to be taxable, we and/or holders of our common stock could be subject to substantial U.S. [taxes]" ; "In connection with the proposed NBCUniversal Spin-off, we have suspended our share repurchase program as of the beginning of the third quarter of 2026" ; "Because completion... will result in two companies that are smaller, each company will incur separate ongoing costs that may be shared today"

controles.affirmation: Gouvernance : 33 1/3% des droits de vote non dilutifs detenus par Brian L. Roberts, avec droit d'approbation distinct sur fusions, cessions d'actifs significatives et operations donnant a un tiers plus de 10% des droits de vote
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "non-dilutable 33 1/3% of the combined voting power of our Class A and Class B common stock" ; "The Class B common stock also has separate approval rights over several potentially material transactions, even if they are approved by our Board of Directors or by our other shareholders and even if they might be in the best interests of our other shareholders. These potentially material transactions include mergers or consolidations involving us, transactions (such as a sale of all or substantially all of our assets) or issuances of securities that require shareholder approval, transactions that result in any person or group owning shares representing more than 10% of the combined voting power..." ; "Brian L. Roberts, our chairman and Co-CEO, beneficially owns all of the outstanding shares of our Class B common stock". La non-dilution n'est reduite que si le nombre d'actions B tombe sous 9 444 375.
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : le veto sur les cessions vise "all or substantially all of our assets", pas toute cession significative. Formulation acceptable mais legerement plus large que le texte.

controles.affirmation: Onze trimestres consecutifs de baisse du haut debit, apres une progression SANS INTERRUPTION du T2 2016 (23 987 000) au pic du T1 2023 (32 324 000)
controles.verbatim_source: Serie kpis-haut CMCSA (broadband_customers) : ... Q1-2022 32,163 ; Q2-2022 32,163 ; Q3-2022 32,177 ; Q4-2022 32,151 ; Q1-2023 32,324. Le T4 2022 est en BAISSE par rapport au T3 2022 (-26 000) et le T2 2022 est stable. La progression n'a donc pas ete ininterrompue. Les 11 trimestres consecutifs de baisse depuis le pic du T1 2023 sont eux exacts (Q2-2023 a Q4-2025).
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer "avait progresse sans interruption de 23 987 000 au T2 2016 jusqu'au pic du T1 2023" par "avait progresse de 23 987 000 au T2 2016 a 32 324 000 au T1 2023, avec un seul trimestre de repli en cours de route (T4 2022)".
